applicant.name: Dr. Renate Pichler
applicant.organisation: Austrian Nephrology Society, kidney health programme

purpose: Public health planning for early detection of reduced kidney function.
question: In each region, how many adults have a measured kidney function, for how many is the latest eGFR below 60 and for how many below 45?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Use the latest eGFR per patient. Patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per region: adults with an eGFR value, adults whose latest eGFR is below 60, adults whose latest eGFR is below 45 and the latter as a share of adults with an eGFR value in %, one decimal.
